title: Auth / session boundary abuse
summary: Prove protected routes or elevated actions are reachable without proper auth.
steps: List auth/admin paths from the capability map.
compare_requests: anonymous vs authenticated to each high-value path.
Forced browse admin/API with cookies stripped; try method overrides (GET→POST) if observed.
Check cookie flags and session after privilege-sensitive actions.
On PASS: unauth access to protected resource or elevated session without credentials.
